key_result: In the synthetic asymmetric regime, selective cost-aware use of stronger evaluator B retained essentially the quality of routing every positive-EVSI case while using about half as many B calls; unconditional all-B escalation was worse. In the symmetric weak-evaluator regime, B residual value was sparse and coarse opportunity-cost routing suppressed all B calls, exposing the need for state-conditioned proposal-pipeline opportunity estimation.
scope: Synthetic archive experiment only; no universal LLM judge thresholds or real-world error rates inferred.
